messages:
Tara: quick sync — i'm worried about penalty spikes from noisy telemetry causing routes to flip. proposal: add a 'hedge_window_ms' to the policy runtime that smooths penalty updates over a short window.

Mike: can you sketch how it differs from ttl/decay? :thinking:

Tara: sure — ttl evicts; decay exponentially reduces penalty over time. hedge_window accumulates transient deltas and only applies when the window average exceeds threshold. avoids reacting to single noisy samples.

Liam: hmm. how does that play with hedged requests? if we delay penalty application, we might keep sending hedges that are expensive.

Tara: good point. plan is to make hedge_window configurable per-penalty-type and introduce a 'fast-path' override for capacity-critical tenants. default: 200ms window, but for Dedicated we may set 50ms.

Sam: can we see a proto DSL? i want to ensure authors can reason about it.

Tara: paste:
```
policy route "gpu-high" {
  penalty_latency_ms = gauge.avg(1000)
  hedge_window_ms = 200
  apply_when = window_avg(penalty_latency_ms, hedge_window_ms) > 250
  override = tenant.has_flag("fast_hedge")
}
```

Irene: looks reasonable. two asks: (1) metrics emitted to trace the pre- vs post-window penalty value, (2) add a runtime flag to force immediate apply for canary rollouts.

Tara: agreed. i'll add metric names: `policy.penalty.pre_window`, `policy.penalty.post_window`. runtime flag `policy.force_apply`.

ops-bot: note: opened RFC ticket #RFC-2026 for hedge-window runtime + perf test plan

Mike: perf tests — include 95/99 p99 token latency with and without hedge_window under synthetic spike workload.

Sam: also test interaction with KV cache invalidation, hedged requests may duplicate KV lookups.

Tara: will attach perf results to RFC. next step: small rollout behind a feature flag for 2 weeks, then consider default on.

Liam: sgtm. timeline?

Tara: plan: implement in runtime next sprint (2w), perf tests + dashboards (1w), feature-flag rollout (2w). total ~5w.

Irene: OK, add escalation doc for rollback if we see cost spike.

Tara: will do. thx everyone :thumbsup:
